uart.signal: crates/firmware-adafruit-feather-rp2350-smoke boots on configs/systems/adafruit-feather-rp2350.yaml and writes the banner to the UART0 PL011 data register at 0x40070000 (no pad mux or baud setup); uart_contains matches it, and gpio_edges requires the red D13 LED on GPIO7, toggled through SIO GPIO_OUT_XOR, to change at least twice.
uart.lane: core-onboarding-smoke (push to main + nightly cron): matrix id adafruit-feather-rp2350 (scripts/onboarding_smoke.sh)

spi.gap: The chip shares the rp2040 PL022 model, but no firmware drives SPI under the rp2350-feather name.

i2c.gap: The chip shares the rp2040 I2C model, but no firmware drives I2C under the rp2350-feather name.
